correctness.rationale: The all-order criterion follows from the exact initial unobserved edge set H[U], permanence of a completely unobserved cycle, and an inductive rooted-forest leaf-stripping forcing sequence using degree at least two. The finite Petersen cycle census is exhaustively generated by DFS and all 32768 line-Petersen subsets are checked by three predicates (direct propagation, DSU forest acyclicity, and containment in ten stars/twelve pentagons). The matching-label optimal-pair classification, 140 minimal triples, four-set orbit exclusion, and TAR components have direct finite certificates in the included scripts. Separately written Kneser and outer/inner/spoke construction programs recover the same counts. No infinite extrapolation from computation is asserted.

value.rationale: The endpoint–forest equivalence turns an iterative power-domination process on every line graph of a minimum-degree-at-least-two root into a static induced-cycle test. The Petersen corollary is a canonical nonclique cubic root with a complete 15-vertex sensor polynomial, exact 140 inclusion-minimal size-three sets, and a structurally sharp token-jumping versus addition/removal mobility separation (five frozen optimal triangles, 140 isolated feasible triples at budget three, connected at four). These are complete, natural invariants of monitoring and reconfiguration, rather than a minor numerical improvement or arbitrary slice; they support future comparisons of observation constraints with graph-cycle geometry.
